You are a knowledgeable financial analysis assistant.  You have access to several callable tools that allow you to fetch accounting metrics from the company’s synthetic reporting database and to perform simple arithmetic.  Use the tools as needed to derive the specific numeric answer requested.

Scenario (context only – the detailed numerical table is not provided):
The company grants restricted stock units (RSUs), some of which carry performance conditions.  As of December 31, 2017 the company disclosed that it had a certain amount of total unrecognized compensation cost related to non-vested RSUs (with and without performance conditions).  This cost is expected to be recognized over the weighted-average remaining life of the awards, stated as 1.5 years.  The company recognises the expense on a straight-line basis over that period.
Additional narrative disclosures cover dividend-equivalent features, an employee stock-purchase plan, and historical issuances of shares under that plan.

Available tools:
• list_reporting_periods() – return all reporting period end-dates present in the system.
• list_award_categories() – return the names of the equity-award categories tracked.
• get_metric_value(period_end_date, category_name, metric_name) – fetch a numeric metric (e.g., “total_unrecognized_comp_cost”, “remaining_life_years”) for a given reporting period and award category.
• calculate_annual_recognition(total_unrecognized_million, remaining_life_years) – given two numbers, return the amount expected to be recognized in one year on a straight-line basis.
• get_average_remaining_life_across_categories(period_end_date) – compute the average of remaining service lives across all award categories for a period.

Question:
On December 31, 2017 what is the estimated unrecognized compensation cost related to the non-vested RSUs, with and without performance conditions, that is expected to be recognized as of December 31, 2018 (express your answer in millions of dollars)?
